column1: # Tatar word-form exceptions for scripts/wordform_gen.py (TT-SUGGESTIONS P1).
# Format: UTF-8, LF, one rule per line: kind<TAB>stem<TAB>payload...
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are skipped. The file is loaded
# fail-closed: any structural error (unknown kind, wrong field count, empty
# field, a word outside the normalized Tatar alphabet, duplicates, an unknown
# override label) aborts the build. This file is pinned by SHA-256 in
#   Possessive-family forms (noun.p1/p2/p3/p1pl/p2pl and the noun.p3.* case
#   forms built on noun.p3) attach to VOICED_STEM; plural, the six cases,
#   noun.p3pl and derivational forms attach to the plain stem. Models
#   stem-final п→б / к→г voicing before vocalic possessive suffixes
#   (китап→китабы but китапка). VOICED_STEM must differ from stem in the final
#   Suppletive paradigm: exactly these forms are emitted (label noun.pron) and
#   regular noun generation for the stem is suppressed (мин → минем миңа …,
#   no минләр). Verb and derivational generation still apply (минде is a real
#   Replaces the generated form for LABEL (a generator label such as
#   verb.pres.3sg or noun.p3). Overriding a person-bearing base
#   (verb.pres.3sg, noun.p3) re-derives the forms built on it (кара → карам…;
#   су → суын/суына/суында/суыннан). An override whose label the stem never
#   emits is an error when that stem is processed.
# Simple future of the -ыр/-ер monosyllable class (the rule generates -ар/-әр
# for monosyllables, -ыр/-ер for longer stems; these six are lexical
# exceptions, attested in kaikki.org Tatar verb tables: барыр, булыр, алыр,
# тулыр, йөрер; калыр added from standard grammar).
# уку is suppletive: укы- for present/past (укый, укыды, укыган, уку) but ук-
# before the future and the negative suffixes (kaikki-attested: укар, укачак,
# укмый, укмас, укмыйча; укмады/укмаган from standard grammar). The 3sg
# overrides re-derive their person forms (укмыйм, укмадым…).
# Masdar of ю ("to wash") is юу, not the glide-spelled *юю.
